tierPurchaseBonusStructureFromV01.interpretationCorrection: m_mapPurchaseBonuses is retained as a separate tier-based purchase-bonus structure and is no longer labeled as the gold-investment breakpoint table.

interpretation.structuralEvidence: m_MapModCostBonuses contains explicit gold thresholds and bonus values, making it the stronger resource candidate for cumulative category-investment breakpoint mechanics.
interpretation.versionBound: Tables are tied to the installed Deadlock build and should not be treated as permanent cross-patch constants.
interpretation.universalMeaning: A table identical across all 42 selectable heroes supports a shared category-progression rule in this installed build.
interpretation.distinctFromItems: These category progression bonuses are separate from the individual stat properties of the items that generated the category investment.
interpretation.distinctFromEffectiveStats: Effective PlayerState(t) still requires current category investment plus items, permanent buffs, temporary buffs, hero scaling, ability states and debuffs.
